Depends on the honeycomb hunt (1–2 hours)

The mermaid {npc:Marina}, of the island of {wiki:Meriana|Meriana}, knows how to turn spider silk into yarn, but hates touching sticky things. Praise her beauty and bring her 50 {item:Honeycomb|Honeycombs}: from then on, she swaps 10 {item:Spider Silk} for a {item:Spool of Yarn} whenever you like.
Access to {wiki:Meriana|Meriana}: the mission *Access to Meriana* of {wiki:The Shattered Isles Quest|The Shattered Isles Quest} (it gives you the secret word {key:peg leg} for the boat).
for every Spool of Yarn you want afterwards
Being able to swap 10 {item:Spider Silk} for 1 {item:Spool of Yarn} with Marina, whenever you want
Swapping Spider Silk for Spool of Yarn with Marina
When you hand 50 {item:Honeycomb|Honeycombs} to {npc:Marina}, in Meriana.
10 {item:Spider Silk} for 1 {item:Spool of Yarn}, whenever you like ({key:silk yarn}).
Always answer **yes** when Marina asks if she is beautiful: it is what she wants to hear.
Collect the 50 honeycombs before going to Meriana so you can do everything in one trip.

In **Liberty Bay**, go to the small peninsula **south-east** of the depot and talk to {npc:Captain Waverider}. Say {key:hi}, {key:peg leg} and {key:yes}: he takes you to **Sabrehaven**, in {wiki:Meriana|Meriana}, for 50 gp. {npc:Marina} is by the **north** coast of the island, north of Sabrehaven.

Go to {wiki:Meriana|Meriana} and talk to the mermaid {npc:Marina}. Say {key:hi}, {key:silk yarn}, {key:yes} (she is beautiful) and {key:yes} again (she is the most dazzling being you have ever seen). She asks you for 50 honeycombs.
On the way and in Meriana you may find {creature:Cobra|Cobras}, {creature:Crab|Crabs}, {creature:Crimson Frog|Crimson Frogs}, {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} and {creature:Rat|Rats}.
With the 50 honeycombs in your inventory, say {key:50 honeycombs} and {key:yes}.
Access to swapping Spider Silk for Spool of Yarn
To go back to **Liberty Bay**, go to {npc:Sebastian}, **south** of Sabrehaven, and say {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay} and {key:yes} (50 gp).
Ask for a Spool of Yarn

Whenever you have **10** {item:Spider Silk}, talk to {npc:Marina} and say {key:hi}, {key:silk yarn} and {key:yes}. You receive a {item:Spool of Yarn}. Make the round trip as before: {npc:Captain Waverider} ({key:peg leg}) from Liberty Bay to Meriana and {npc:Sebastian} ({key:liberty bay}) back.
